text:
Alex W: All-hands in ~6 — doing a quick AV/stream check. @Jamie (AV) can you confirm recorder + captions are green? :wave:
Priya K: Just saw the deck upload finish. mic checks OK on my end.
Jamie (AV): Recorder running, local disk at 64% free. Captions service connected but latency is 1.2s — acceptable. Will watch. :thumbsup:
Sasha - Eng: Heads up — last deploy to console dashboard could surface a small spike in metrics. Not blocking live but expect a couple Redis warnings.
Tyler H: Obs is showing a weird black frame on camera 2 for me. Jamie can you swap to camera 1 preview?
Jamie (AV): Swapped preview to cam-1. Cam-2 appears to have a loose HDMI — reseated and image back.
Alex W: Thanks. @Kieran (CEO) you on for intro at :03?
Kieran (CEO): Yep, I'll be live. Quick ask: can we record the Q&A as a separate clip for social?
Jamie (AV): Yep — will mark a clip timestamp and export after meeting.
Ops-bot: Recording started by Jamie (AV) — meeting_id=ah-2026-03-23-2369123456
Priya K: Noted for the clip. Also a couple roadmap q's that came in — can we hold 5 extra minutes at the end if leadership wants to take follow-ups?
Kieran (CEO): Happy to extend +5 if needed.
Sasha - Eng: Regarding the console metric spike — it's benign, but if ingest > 700r/s we may delay dashboards for ~30s. Shouldn't affect the stream.
Tyler H: Re: black frame, if it happens again here's a quick restart I use on the AV rig: ```
# quick obs soft-restart
pkill -f obs || true
sleep 2
nohup obs --startstreaming &>/dev/null &
```
Jamie (AV): Got that. Will use soft-restart if cam glitch recurs.
Alex W: Also, captions drifted ~300ms earlier — any way to reduce that?
Jamie (AV): Captions come from 3rd-party transcribe, queueing adds latency. I can push audio via direct RTMP to alternate transcriber (lower latency) but it may reduce caption quality slightly. Preferences?
Priya K: Lower latency preferred for live Q&A. Go ahead.
Kieran (CEO): Lower latency > slight drop in accuracy for live. Good trade.
Jamie (AV): Switched RTMP target to transcriber-lowlatency. Latency now ~400ms.
Sasha - Eng: Noted — console alerting will still reflect the earlier deploy warnings. I'll watch for any unexpected errors but won't mute alerts.
Tyler H: Minor: Slack screen-share to OBS had window cropping — re-add the window capture if anyone sees a black band.
Jamie (AV): Re-added window capture, locked layer.
Alex W: Quick reminder — if we need to do a canary rollout to the hosted API during the all-hands, don't. Save to after the meeting unless it's an emergency.
Sasha - Eng: Understood. We'll park any non-critical rollouts.
Priya K: One last: can folks drop follow-up Qs in #product after the meeting? We'll collate answers and post a short summary.
Kieran (CEO): Yes please. Tag me for anything roadmap-specific.
Jamie (AV): Recording mark: start-clip @ 2369123575 for highlight reel.
Ops-bot: Clip tag recorded by Jamie (AV) — clip_id=clip-2369123575
Alex W: Perfect. If any last hiccups, ping here. Going live in 2.
Tyler H: all good from infra side.
Priya K: good to go — thanks everyone.
Kieran (CEO): Let's do it. :rocket:
